```{r}
tcell_clusts <- c("16", "15", "24", "22")
tcell_tbl <- mpn_processed_mnc@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9) %>%
  group_by(sample.name)%>%
  mutate(n = n/sum(n))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% tcell_clusts) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample.name, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(mch_neg = (`MNC_mCh-`-MNC_WT)/MNC_WT,
         mch_pos = (`MNC_mCh+`-MNC_WT)/MNC_WT) %>%
    arrange(desc(mch_neg))%>%
  mutate(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 = factor(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9, levels = unique(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9)))%>%

  pivot_longer(cols = c(mch_neg, mch_pos),names_to = "grp")
  
tcell_tbl %>%
  ggplot(aes(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9, value, fill = grp))+
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(), color = "black")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("24"="NK_24",
                              "16"="CD4_16",
                              "15"="CD8_15",
                              "22" = "DC_22"),
                   name = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative abundance \n (Fold change)")+
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
neut_cycle_clusts <- c("8", "21", "27")
neut_clusts <- c("11", "4", "14", "30", "2", "26", "1", "9")
neut_olfm_clusts <- c("10")


neut_tbl <- mpn_processed_mnc@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 = case_when(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% neut_cycle_clusts ~ "neut_cycle",
                                            sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% neut_clusts ~ "neut",
                                            sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% neut_olfm_clusts ~ "neut_olfm",
                                            .default = sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9))%>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9) %>%
  group_by(sample.name)%>%
  mutate(n = n/sum(n))%>%
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% c("neut_cycle", "neut", "neut_olfm")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample.name, values_from = n) %>%
  mutate(mch_neg = (`MNC_mCh-`-MNC_WT)/MNC_WT,
         mch_pos = (`MNC_mCh+`-MNC_WT)/MNC_WT) %>%
  arrange(desc(mch_neg))%>%
  mutate(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 = factor(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9, levels = unique(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9)))%>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mch_neg, mch_pos),names_to = "grp")
  
neut_tbl %>%
  ggplot(aes(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9, value, fill = grp))+
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(), color = "black")+
    scale_x_discrete(
                     name = "")+
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Relative abundance \n (Fold change)")+
  coord_flip()
```

```{r}
gs_lst <-msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",
                 collection = "H",
                 subcollection = NULL) %>%
    with(.,split(gene_symbol, gs_name))

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::AddModuleScore(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,gs_lst["HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY"])

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            c("Cluster1"), 
            order = TRUE,
            pt.size = 0.1,
            ncol = 1,
            split.by = "sample.name")&
  RestoreLegend()&
  viridis::scale_color_viridis(option = "turbo", limit = c(-0.2, 0.36))
```
